_about: Answers to reply-to-designer-01 §3(a) and §3(b): accent per theme category, and the tier-count → rung mapping. Companion to theme-standard.md / theme-presets.json.

new_accents._about: MERGED into theme-presets.json accents as of reply 06 — kept here for the rationale only. Do not treat this as a second bank.

equipment.note: ALL gear classes share ONE accent. Gear is separated by the game's own rarity text, never by class colour — 30 weapon/armour ladders wearing 30 hues is the thing this design exists to prevent. No icon, no beam: gear is judged by reading the label.

vendor.note: Legacy, vendor recipes, chancing. The noise floor as a category rather than a rung.

flasks.note: Life/Mana/Utility/Tinctures. Uses Raindrop — one of the four shapes held in reserve; a flask is not any of the other eight.

quest.note: Quest Items, Magic Net. Green is the game's own quest convention. Always visible regardless of strictness.

allflame.note: Curse of the Allflame, Enshrouding Crystals, Enshrouded Gear. Ember orange, clear of currency's yellow-orange.

corpses.note: Necropolis corpses. Flesh tone — deliberately unlike anything tradeable.

accent_by_category._about: All 75. Several share one accent, as you said was fine. 'equipment' covers every gear class.

notes_on_judgement_calls.Heist split: Contracts / Blueprints / Targets / Heist Currency take the heist accent. Heist Equipment and Heist Experimented are GEAR — rarity matters on them, so they go to equipment and lose the red. Heist red identifies the mechanic's own drops, not gear that happens to come from it.
notes_on_judgement_calls.Campaign: 62 rungs of weapon/armour progression → equipment, same as the rest of gear. Its ladder is per-file; see rung_by_depth.gear.
notes_on_judgement_calls.Body Armours: 10 rungs because Fractured.json still resolves here. Take it off, per your recommendation — see the reply's §2.
notes_on_judgement_calls.States: _decorators/States.json is the state-border decorator file, not a themed category. It emits from state_borders in theme-presets.json and takes no accent.
notes_on_judgement_calls.Magic Net: Utility rather than loot, so it sits with Quest Items on green. If you would rather it read as Bestiary brown, that is a one-line change.

rung_by_depth._about: Six rungs, T0-T5 (there is no T6). Rungs listed best-first. Applies PER LADDER (per file), not per theme category.

value._for: currency, league mechanics, consumables, maps, fragments, gems, jewels, uniques, flasks, quest

gear._for: every category on the equipment accent, plus Heist Equipment / Experimented
gear._why: A gear ladder is ilvl bands, not a value ladder — its top rung is a good crafting base, not a chase drop.

overrides._about: Where depth alone gets it wrong.
